steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Add the Technical Stage while retaining the Auction stage.
Provide the required project title so the missing Auction template is the isolated publish condition.
Configure the Technical Stage before testing publish.
Return to the Auction stage, which must remain without a template.
Add the required project line item; line items can be added even though the Auction template is omitted.
Complete the Technical Stage configuration after the project item exists.
Fill the Technical Stage questionnaire requirements.
Assign the evaluator required for a technical stage.
Return to the incomplete Auction stage.
Commit a valid schedule so scheduling is not the publish blocker.
